description: This file defines and exports various type definitions, functions, and constants related to the 'line' plugin API, acting as an aggregation and re-export of symbols from multiple modules within the openclaw plugin SDK and local runtime files.

methods.name: clearAccountEntryFields
methods.description: Resets account entry fields in the plugin SDK core module.

methods.name: buildChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Builds a configuration schema for line channel.

methods.name: buildComputedAccountStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the account's status based on current data.

methods.name: buildTokenChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of token channel statuses.

methods.name: createActionCard
methods.description: Creates an action card message for the line channel.

methods.name: listLineAccountIds
methods.description: Lists the line account IDs associated with the plugin.

methods.name: resolveDefaultLineAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default account ID for the line plugin.

methods.name: resolveExactLineGroupConfigKey
methods.description: Resolves configuration keys for line groups.

methods.name: resolveLineAccount
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves line account details.

methods.name: splitSetupEntries
methods.description: Splits setup configuration entries into components.
